summary: Candidate is a knowledge_reference for the Executor interface contract in concurrent.futures, semantically distinct from existing skills which cover Virtual WAN routing concepts. No existing skill shares the same asset_type, granularity, domain, task_family, or method_family. The peer_candidates (Executor Lifecycle Management, ThreadPoolExecutor Context Manager Setup, ThreadPoolExecutor Configuration) are session_skill layer implementations that depend on this knowledge_reference but do not subsume it. The candidate provides foundational interface documentation needed by those peers.
